reason: The Vita system failed to address my direct, repeated questions about driving range, tyre pressure safety, and maintenance alerts. Instead, it provided irrelevant climate control and air quality data. The range estimate (10.8 km at 78% battery) appears erroneous and was never clarified. Critical safety information for a long drive was not delivered.
clarifyingNotes: The system did not provide: (1) confirmation that tyre pressures of 2.4/2.4 bar front and 2.3/2.4 bar rear are within safe specifications; (2) a reliable or explained driving range estimate; (3) any maintenance alerts or service reminders; (4) clarification of the discrepancy between 78% battery and only 10.8 km remaining range. The responses were repetitive and off-topic, cycling between mode switches and climate settings rather than addressing diagnostic concerns essential for safe long-distance driving.
